author: Indicado
body:
Hi. Welcome to this new map :D! (I got the permission of KylerDurrDurr to do this map)

Block Fort TE

  • Map created by KylerDurrDurr and Yunooo
  • TDM-based,8 vs 8
  • Inspired in the Mario Kart game.
Screenshots: (Album: http://imgur.com/a/k0gf5)

title: [TDM] Block Fort TE

replies.author: AIDSquirt
replies.body: I like this map a lot! It looks fun to play on-- I'd only request that there would be the redstone lines around spawns to prevent spawnkilling, there's always a problem with that on the original map!
replies.body_tagged: I like this map a lot! It looks fun to play on-- I'd only request that there would be the redstone lines around spawns to prevent spawnkilling, there's always a problem with that on the original map!

replies.author: Indicado
replies.body: The spawnkilling its not a problem since you spawn with resistance 5,5 seconds.

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
I don't really think that the map would work as a tournament map. Mainly because there is not enough cover, complicated spawns and just the map design in general.
The map is better suited for FFA.
